title: #303 Environment of Growth
prompt: It is better for children to grow up in big cities than in the countryside. To what extent do you agree with this statement？

promptSegments.text: It is better for children to grow up in big cities than in the countryside.
To what extent do you agree with this statement？

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: City life provides children with numerous activities and sights, such as museums and large parks, which helps them learn and interact with many people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City life provides children with numerous activities and sights, such as museums and large parks, which helps them learn and interact with many people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: City life offers superior educational resources, as schools in cities typically have better teachers and more facilities, leading to a good education and friendships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City life offers superior educational resources, as schools in cities typically have better teachers and more facilities, leading to a good education and friendships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The countryside provides a better environment for physical health and natural development.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The countryside provides a better environment for physical health and natural development.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Country life offers strong community support and a sense of belonging that is vital for emotional growth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Country life offers strong community support and a sense of belonging that is vital for emotional growth.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: City life provides better educational opportunities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City life provides better educational opportunities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: City life offers a wider range of facilities and activities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City life offers a wider range of facilities and activities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary argument against city life is the superior health benefits found in rural settings.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary argument against city life is the superior health benefits found in rural settings.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second argument focuses on the negative impact of urban pollution and stress on a child's mental well-being.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second argument focuses on the negative impact of urban pollution and stress on a child's mental well-being.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
